title: Verify workspace portability and recovery
description: Use versioned fixtures and browser acceptance tests to verify current round trips, older migrations, corruption/future refusal, rollback, deletion, offline operation, and mandatory registration of future durable types.
acceptanceCriteria: Current and supported older fixtures validate, report migrations, commit, and reproduce expected canonical state
Corrupt assets/records, duplicate IDs, broken references, and unsupported future versions are refused before mutation
Injected commit failures preserve byte/logical equivalence of the original workspace and report rollback
Export, report review, import, rollback, individual deletion, and total deletion pass keyboard browser tests offline
A test-only unregistered durable type fails bundle completeness, import participation, migration, and deletion checks
No workflow uploads data or claims to delete user-downloaded backups

steps.details: Create current, supported-old, corrupt, duplicate, missing-asset, broken-reference, future-version, and bounded hostile fixtures with explicit expected findings.
Export/import into clean context, compare all registered canonical records/assets/relationships/scenes/PDF hashes, and inspect migration reports.
Assert no pre-commit mutation for invalid fixtures and exact pre-state preservation for injected commit failures and cancelled plans.
Exercise dependent/complete deletion and add a test repository type that must fail closed until all portability hooks are registered.
Run focused Playwright keyboard flows with network disabled plus relevant unit, build, and lint checks; inspect progress/status and no-upload behavior.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; run the intentionally small focused fixtures and browser filters only.
Keep fixture records intentionally small so this verification slice remains under ten minutes.
Software round trips and hashes prove portability/determinism only, never physical printing, placement, calibration, or safe refeeding.
